snippet.title: Bomb Kitten - Trailer (eastasiasoft)
snippet.description: Play as Bomb Kitten, a cunning black cat in a red cape, in this old-school action puzzler! Blast through grid-based stages, outsmart enemies, and use bombs to clear paths—but watch for spikes and traps.
